rationale:
Retain program_20 unchanged as the frozen exploratory candidate for a matched-native paired generation comparison, not as an independently validated winner. Its reported mean_pic50_delta is +0.2302989435, validity change +0.010000, MMFF_relief_per_heavy median/p90 0.476946/0.954550, and best_valid_pic50 8.237148. The mean advantages over program_3 (+0.2292925739) and program_4 (+0.2293644285) are only 0.00100637 and 0.000934515; paired uncertainty is not supplied. Program_4 has a higher best valid score 8.558043 but validity change -0.020000. Program_19 has lower mean +0.2128393650 and lower p90 0.907866; program_8 has p90 0.731024 and mean +0.139001489. These discovery tradeoffs support a frozen comparison, not a material-strain guarantee. The beta=0 endpoint sibling program_1 already gains +0.214474702, so beta=2 and dose 0.33 are retained settings, not inferred optima.

The selected registered family is endpoint_pointcloud in receptor/world coordinates. Keep intact teacher coordinates, Hungarian squared-distance correspondences, nearest K=4, detached offline score/geometric priors with teacher temperature 4 A^2 and beta=2, mixture tau=0.5, source-program robust_delta=2, native_rms_ratio=0.33, predictive_flow dose reference, and time_ramp_power=0. No scalar or reference update is proposed. Use the registry formula q_m=mean_i||Y_i-T_m,assignment(i)||^2, rho_delta(q)=delta^2(sqrt(1+q/delta^2)-1), R=tau*logsumexp(log(pi_m)-rho_delta(q_m)/tau), with the exact existing reference and its registered conditional prior. Geometry block weights [0,1,2,1] remain monitoring weights; the point-cloud loss uses coordinates directly. R has a finite upper bound, not a finite lower bound.

Execution remains g_t=J_Y(FLOWR,x_t; detached self-conditioning)^T grad_Y R(Y), using the graph of the already required native forward. Freeze self-conditioning, endpoint anchor, teacher assignment, nearest-K selection and priors in this derivative. The same joint forward emits endpoint forecasts and a pooled-latent affinity-head score; the head is not an endpoint-coordinate-only affinity evaluator. Detach/exclude affinity outputs from the loss. Return detached native predictions/self-conditioning for native stochastic integration, then add the bounded coordinate VJP after that step. This gradient is exact at old x_t; its lagged injection at x_(t+dt) yields only a first-order predicted endpoint reward change without a new forward. No identity/saved-endpoint/surrogate derivative, head gradient, extra production forward/head call, SMC, cloning, graph/composition veto or topology lock is introduced. Positive scheduling covers all 50 supplied nodes t=0.00,...,0.49 within the evidence-derived window [0,0.5], except a vanishing mathematical gradient; finish native steps to 1. Retain source-program caps (0.15 A per atom, cumulative RMS 6 A, 7 backtracking attempts, severe receptor clash threshold 0.8 A), and report actual dose, caps, rejections and native continuation.

Observed endpoint compaction associations nominate geometry hypotheses, not causal binding regions: shape_xx=-0.495325 z (q=0.000812746), shape_yy=-0.512823 z (q=0.0000149366), and pair_kernel_2.5=+0.630662 z (q=0.0000218888, 14/14 positive batches). All 24 audited fitted endpoint curves are runtime-disallowed (relative RMSE 0.385913..0.931375, above 0.35), and every one of the 63 empirical regional curves crosses zero. Thus no polynomial or monotone direction is added. Under the stated reproducibility rule, region 00 is the strongest positive soft-mass association (+0.639234994 z, CI [0.492460,0.790651], q=0.000187945471, 14/14 positive batches), yet its first/last-node z values are -0.365951/-0.275338. This contradiction precludes constant signed attraction. Overlapping Gaussian regions and widespread negative covariance contrasts do not establish independent motifs or justify universal compression. Regional programs 5/12/19 have means +0.213974/+0.203369/+0.212839, below the retained candidate. Full geometry is a permitted tested representation, not causally proven superior: information-audit compressed/full teacher-score correlations are 0.101826/0.064078, and its excess RMS 0.080974 A is nonnegative by construction.

Do not replace the reference with a survival rule. Zero of the 400 jointly BH-corrected survival tests reaches q<0.05 (minimum q=0.120426553). The lineage packet reports 349/700 batch-nodes with fewer than 3 ancestors and 531/700 with fewer than 6; teacher counts rise 17 to 28, capped at 2 per batch. Node ancestor medians and direct terminal-credit contrasts are not supplied. Survival labels are terminal-conditioned at recorded head-score time 0.99/state time 1.0, not immediate end-window retention or decoded final-molecule affinity rescores. Extinction credit remains missing/null, never zero. Sparse early support cannot justify full-window high/low credit stratification, clone-count teacher weights, or a claimed survival-to-final-affinity mechanism. None of those changes is compiled.

The bound registry maps round09 to program_0 (mean delta -0.041429; p90 1.550371; window-shape improvement fraction 0.014364) and round10 to program_18 (dose 0.51; mean delta +0.206789; validity -0.020000; p90 0.957898), which does not beat round07/program_3 at dose 0.3 and mean +0.229293. Round06/program_9 has mean -0.006339 and shape fraction -0.005112. These supplied quantities do not measure the requested R6/R9 window-to-final reward loss. The four numeric dose-diagnostic cases, FLOWR finite differences, full 100-step zero/native parity, injection RMS, individual absolute changes, terminal persistence and historical Steer comparison are absent. Consequently no weak-dose or active-control conclusion is asserted from the signed mean or window-shape fraction. Policy for a future complete diagnostic packet: a small signed mean with large absolute/delivered responses is active control; a genuinely flat response first checks delivered dose before strength exploration; negative final affinity motivates target/feature revision; positive gain below measured Steer retains/refines the promising parent. No stronger dose is presumed better.

Freeze this candidate before fresh matched batches and never retune from validation/heldout outcomes. Report all attempt/failure denominators, score coverage, mean and unique mean, valid/unique means, best valid/PB-fast and unique Top5 separately, then secondary strain among comparable-affinity programs with a declared material-regression criterion. Bound summaries lack many of these metrics and an absolute native strain baseline. Schema validity here does not certify GPU execution or final affinity. The declared path/reference are unchanged; renewed directional-derivative audit and full 100-step zero/native equivalence are required on any path/reference switch, with one-time extra audit forwards logged separately. Independent review precedes activation.

failure_modes: Adaptive reused discovery batches, unresolved near ties and missing paired intervals can reverse the candidate ranking; retain_existing selects a comparison candidate, not acceptance.

All-failure denominators, absolute score coverage, unique means/Top5, PB-fast, diversity, native strain baseline and a material-strain margin are missing; no complete quality or strain guarantee follows.

Delivered coordinate dose, finite differences, zero/native parity, injection RMS and terminal persistence are unbound; do not call the control weak, inactive or certified from the small signed mean or a shape fraction.
Actual-state features and matched actual/endpoint associations are absent; endpoint forecast statistics cannot establish current contacts or a representation intervention relative to actual states.
Runtime-disallowed fits, zero-crossing regional curves and overlapping Gaussian regions invalidate an invented temporal law, universal compression or constant signed regional attraction.

Terminal-conditioned lineage is sparse and none of 400 survival tests passes joint BH; missing extinction credit, node ancestor medians and early credit contrasts cannot be filled or forced into full-window strata.
Conditional assignments, priors and attention must stay detached; differentiating recomputed memberships or the affinity head would change the experiment.
Lagged post-native reward logs are first-order predictions at old x_t, not measured post-step reward improvements; caps/backtracking may reduce actual delivery and must be reported.
The legacy role mentions four numeric cases and R6/R9 window-to-final losses, but those measurements are not bound; registry round mappings do not supply the missing diagnostics.

The selected program/reference hashes are checked or recorded as bound metadata; reference contents, source reward implementation and GPU inference were not audited here. Any formula/path/reference change requires renewed review and execution checks.
